newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County, Utah.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County, Utah.

text.p: General Obligation Public Safety Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids for the purchase of $9,900,000 Washington County, Utah General Obligation Public Safety Bonds, Series 1997 (dated January 15, 1997) will be received up to 9:30 A.M. (MDT), on

at the offices of Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111. The Bonds will be dated January 15, 1997 and will be fully registered bonds, in book-entry form, in denominations of $5,000 or integral multiples thereof, and will mature serially on December 1 as follows:

Copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale, the Official Statement, and other related information with respect to the Bonds being offered subject to the approval as to the legality of Ballard Spahr Andrews & Ingersoll, Salt Lake City, Utah, may be obtained from Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 524-2100, fax: (801) 524-2109, the Financial Advisor to Washington County.
